title: TFT Comp
description: A hand-authored or (in Phase 3) machine-derived Teamfight Tactics team composition. schemaVersion tracks this file's shape so Phase 3's harvested-and-clustered comps can be validated and rendered by the same detail view without a UI change.

schemaVersion.description: Semver of this schema, not of the comp. Bump when the shape of this file changes.

id.description: Kebab-case slug, unique within data/comps/, stable across patches so the overlay can keep a user's pinned/favorited comp across updates.

set.description: TFT set number this comp is written for, e.g. 18.

patch.description: Patch this comp was authored/validated against, e.g. "18.1". A comps site or harvester (Phase 3, option b) can supersede a comp by publishing a newer patch value under the same id.

source.description: Provenance of this comp's data. Phase 1 shipped hand-authored only; match-derived is Phase 3's planned Riot-match-clustering pipeline; licensed-feed is an explicit data-sharing agreement with a third party (neither implemented). scraped-feed (ADR 0004) is a maintainer-run scraper over a public tier-list site's page content, with no license from that site -- see ADR 0004 for why this was judged acceptable and what it does NOT cover (the scraper never runs from the shipped app).

tier.description: Editorial power ranking for the current patch.

playstyle.description: fast_8: level aggressively to 8 and roll down there. slow_roll: hold level, roll at a fixed level to 3-star cheap units before leveling further. reroll: commit to leveling low and rerolling for one or two 3-starred cheap/mid units.

name.description: Champion name exactly as it appears in-game this set.

starTarget.description: Star level this comp expects the unit to reach by the fight that matters (usually final board).

flex.description: True if this unit is a common swap-out depending on lobby contest, not a core piece.

unit.description: Must match a units[].name entry with role "carry".

itemPriority.description: Completed items in priority order, best-in-slot first.

grid.description: 4 rows x 7 hex columns, your side of the board. Row 0 is the frontline row (closest to the enemy), row 3 is the row closest to your bench. Each cell is a unit name from units[] or null for an empty hex.

notes.description: Positioning callouts that a grid can't express, e.g. corner vs. center hiding for a backline carry.

augmentPreferences.description: Preferred augments per silver/gold/prismatic tier, most preferred first. Empty arrays are valid if no augment is a standout for this comp.

earlyOpener.description: Stages 1-1 through 2-5: what to greed/prioritize before the comp's identity is committed to.

pivotNotes.description: When this comp is contested or the opener whiffs, what to pivot into and the tell that triggers it.
